verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes SQL/HogQL for querying and modifying data across large sets of events, plus a general HTTP API (openapi.json) and CLI for scripting, which could be used to script bulk actions, but no docs explicitly describe a bulk-operations feature (e.g., batch update/delete of flags, cohorts, or insights) for AI agents. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or agent workflows for operating on many items at once, hands-on evidence of bulk automation succeeding.
